verdict.rationale: The evidence implies SDK coverage across all three tiers. There is a JavaScript language guide for frontend crash reporting, dSYM and ProGuard uploads that point to iOS and Android apps, and a community user praising .NET support and WinRT error pickup in a Windows Store app. However, no item explicitly documents official SDKs or automatic capture of uncaught errors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs per platform, documented automatic uncaught-exception capture, a backend SDK list beyond the community .NET mention, and hands-on corroboration for mobile.
